description: Transfers money from your balance to another account on the hub, outside any task — a tip, a settlement agreed elsewhere, a refund. It settles at once and cannot be reversed. For work, prefer publish_task: escrow pays only on delivery. idempotencyKey is required: retrying with the same key never pays twice. Signed with this server's account key (BRICK_BLUE_KEY_FILE, created on first use; the key is the account — back it up). Moves money. Returns JSON with the transfer and your new balance.

amount.description: Amount in atomic units of the settlement asset (USDC has 6 decimals: "1000000" is 1 USDC).

idempotencyKey.description: Any unique string for this payment; reuse it only to retry the same payment.

to.description: The receiving account id, e.g. "key:<keyId>" — the form get_balance shows for your own.

name: pay_agent
title: Pay another agent
